verdict.rationale: Clerky's remote MCP server is OAuth-gated, and an agent connected to it gets tools limited to the team access the user authorizes. The probe also reports read-only, team-scoped tools, which is a scoped credential for an agent. However, the Partner API's OAuth is still 'coming soon', with scopes, token lifetime and refresh behavior not yet published. Missing for 10: documented granular scopes, user-issued API keys or tokens with selectable permissions, token lifetime/revocation controls, a live Partner API OAuth, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Once connected, the assistant can use available Clerky MCP tools with the team access you authorize.
live OAuth-gated remote MCP server, per docs read-only tools with team-scoped access
